$comment: T-181.43 negative golden. Identical to a valid document except slots[0].groupCallsign reads 'AL<TAB>PHA' instead of 'Alpha'. This is the EXACT value from the T-181.42 incident, and before the wireSafeString pattern it was a SCHEMA-VALID mission: mission.schema.json put minLength:1 and no pattern on the field, TBD_SpawnManager.BuildSlotRoster formatted it into a tab-delimited roster row, and the extra column shifted every field after it — role rendered as 'PHA', the real role landed in the STATE column so the seat matched neither OPEN nor DEAD and became UNSELECTABLE, and holderId parsed from "OPEN".ToInt() = 0. The mod now rewrites the character at the source (TBD_SpawnManager.RosterField) and the lobby parser is pinned to exact arity, so this fixture guards the LAST line rather than the only one — but a rewritten callsign is still not the callsign the author wrote. See README.md for the wrapper format — this is NOT a mission document.

mustFail.because: a TAB in an authored callsign opens a seventh column in the tab-delimited roster wire; every field after it shifts and the seat becomes unselectable rather than failing loudly
